introHtml: You are what you drink. Answer a few totally scientific questions to find out which juice you really are.

questions.prompt: How would your friends describe you?

results.title: Orange Juice
results.contentHtml: Bright, dependable, and full of vitamin C. You're the reason people get out of bed in the morning.

results.title: Prune Juice

results.contentHtml: Your friends don't understand you, but your electrolytes have never been better.
